Status: Wave 317 accepted (6.3): the IoT software updater

Method.evidence: Class465 is the 6.3 IoTSoftwareUpdater: 6.4's SoftwareUpdate.Class184 writes its own logger category as "Knx.Ets.Hawk.Impl.IoT.Tasks.SoftwareUpdate.IoTSoftwareUpdater", keeps the same project-data and async-network-access-provider fields, and declares ApplyFirmwareUpdateAsync(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> packageData, Version firmwareVersion, int maxBytesPerTransfer, IProgress<HawkProgressIndication> progressReport, ...) -> Task<IoTSoftwareUpdateResult>. Class465's single apply method has the same parameter order (its last parameter is a CancellationToken in this build) and its body reports HawkProgressIndication with the same Resources.FirmwareUpdate_Transferring string. The 6.3 class is the thinner version of that class, so the Reason records the literal plus the responsibility rather than a one-to-one member set.
Method.themes: Starts the SoftwareUpdate twin. The class's own return enum (wb) has no readable 6.4 counterpart in HawkNET and stays free; the two collaborator getters return whitelist-protected types (l6, fb) and stay free with them.
